_notes: Vanilla 26.3 batch A. BlockUseFixtures supplies the server, use-item-on dispatch, packet and game-event recorders and ordered write observer. Each case resets the level random and the named harvest/carve loot streams to randomSeed (1234 by default). Food, saturation, all inventory slots, hive occupants/bee targets and campfire smoke are also recorded. Every case records exact item drop positions. Setup is quiet; smoke fixtures clear seven cells below the target. The bystander is a spectator, so bee targets have one eligible player.
